title: Do Deepfake Detectors Work in Reality?
abstract: arXiv:2502.10920v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deepfakes, particularly those involving faceswap-based manipulations, have sparked significant societal concern due to their increasing realism and potential for misuse. Despite rapid advancements in generative models, detection methods have not kept pace, creating a critical gap in defense strategies. This disparity is further amplified by the disconnect between academic research and real-world applications, which often prioritize different objectives and evaluation criteria. In this study, we take a pivotal step toward bridging this gap by presenting a novel observation: the post-processing step of super-resolution, commonly employed in real-world scenarios, substantially undermines the effectiveness of existing deepfake detection methods. To substantiate this claim, we introduce and publish the first real-world faceswap dataset, collected from popular online faceswap platforms. We then qualitatively evaluate the performance

translated_title: 深度伪造检测器在现实中有效吗？
translated_abstract: 深度伪造，特别是基于人脸交换的篡改技术，由于其日益逼真的效果和潜在的滥用风险，引发了严重的社会关注。尽管生成式模型迅速发展，但检测方法并未跟上步伐，在防御策略上造成了关键性的缺口。学术研究与现实应用之间的脱节进一步放大了这一差距，因为两者往往优先考虑不同的目标和评估标准。在本研究中，我们朝着弥合这一差距迈出了关键一步，提出了一个新颖的观察结果：现实场景中常用的超分辨率后处理步骤会大大削弱现有深度伪造检测方法的有效性。为了证实这一观点，我们引入并发布了首个真实世界的人脸交换数据集，该数据集收集自流行的在线人脸交换平台。随后，我们对性能进行了定性评估。
tldr: 该研究揭示现实场景中常用的超分辨率后处理会显著削弱现有深度伪造检测方法的有效性，并发布了首个从在线人脸交换平台收集的真实世界人脸交换数据集来验证这一发现。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that super-resolution post-processing, commonly used in real-world scenarios, substantially undermines existing deepfake detection methods, and introduces the first real-world faceswap dataset collected from online faceswap platforms to substantiate this finding.
